name: VIX calm regime + RSI dip — buy dips only when equity vol is low (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why VIX regime leads dip resolution): the VIX is equity-implied volatility and a cross-asset fear gauge; crypto's beta to the macro risk regime means dips resolve very differently by VIX state. In a CALM regime (low VIX) a crypto dip is a routine shakeout that recovers; in a HIGH-VIX regime the same dip is the front edge of a cross-asset risk-off cascade and continues down. VIX conditions the environment ahead of the crypto tape, so it tells a buyable dip from a dangerous one. We require vix_level below a fitted ceiling AND an RSI dip, and exit if the VIX spikes up through its stress level (regime broke). Distinct from vix-calm-MOMENTUM (which rides trends in calm): this BUYS DIPS in calm. DISCONFIRMER 1: if a plain RSI-dip buy matches the deflated Sharpe, the VIX gate adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2: VIX is next-day-available (FRED lag) — if the edge needs intraday VIX it is look-ahead. tier0 macro read; low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: vix_level is BELOW a fitted calm ceiling (low equity-implied vol) while RSI has dipped.
